title: Reproducibility Package: Invisible Mitigation: Why Default Methane Accounting Cannot See What Dairy Farmers Do
description: Complete code and reproducibility package for a study formally demonstrating that the IPCC Tier 1 national greenhouse gas inventory method is structurally unable to register farm-level, diet-mediated enteric methane mitigation in dairy cattle, illustrated using a mechanistic enteric-methane model combined with four candidate mitigation levers parameterized with U.S. Holstein performance and price data. Running code/run_all.py reproduces every table and figure reported in the manuscript, with internal verification assertions checking every output against its reported value.
